# mv: rename an exported var (rewriteUses exported path)
mv X Y
-- x.go --
package m

var X = 1
-- y.go --
package m

func F() int { return X }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 package m

-var X = 1
+var Y = 1
diff old/y.go new/y.go
--- old/y.go
+++ new/y.go
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 package m

-func F() int { return X }
+func F() int { return Y }
